name: embedded-react-debug
description: Debug an embedded-react app in its own source: breakpoints, stepping and state, on a board through a debug probe or in the simulator with no board.

embedded-react.cli.description: The embedded-react CLI to run the debug adapter from. Empty finds the package in the project's node_modules.

embedded-react.node.description: The Node.js that runs the debug adapter.

enumDescriptions: Show the simulator in a split to the right of the code.
Open the simulator in the default browser.
Leave it closed: its address is printed in the debug console.
embedded-react.openSimulator.description: Where the simulator shows when a debug session starts it.

program.description: The firmware's ELF, as the board runs it.

debugFile.description: The app's debug file: the app.erdbg the build writes beside the package.

target.description: Where the GDB server listens, as GDB's `target remote` takes it.

gdb.description: The GDB for the board: version 14 or later, built with Python.

source.description: The app's source file, when it isn't found beside the debug file.

cwd.description: The folder GDB and the GDB server run in.

server.description: A GDB server to start with the session and end with it: the program and its arguments.

serverReady.description: Text the GDB server prints when GDB can connect. Without it, the session waits for the target's port.

serverTimeout.description: How long to wait for the GDB server, in milliseconds.

setupCommands.description: GDB commands to run before the ELF is loaded.

postAttachCommands.description: GDB commands to run once it is connected to the board.

disconnectCommands.description: GDB commands to run before the session ends, with the board halted.

stopOnAttach.description: Leave the board halted once attached.

environment.description: Environment variables for GDB and the GDB server, over the editor's own.

simulator.description: Attach to a Flow B simulator that is running (embedded-react dev --aot), with no board: true, or where it listens, such as localhost:3333.

program.description: A Flow B host program to run under GDB. Not for the simulator.

debugFile.description: The app's debug file: the app.erdbg the build writes beside the package.

gdb.description: The GDB to run: version 14 or later, built with Python.

source.description: The app's source file, when it isn't found beside the debug file.

cwd.description: The folder the program runs in, or the app's project for the simulator.

setupCommands.description: GDB commands to run before the program is loaded.

environment.description: Environment variables for GDB and the GDB server, over the editor's own.

simulator.description: Debug the app in the Flow B simulator, with no board: true, or where one listens, such as localhost:3333.

entry.description: The app's component file, when it isn't ./App.jsx or ./src/App.jsx. For the simulator.

screen.description: The simulator's panel size, as <width>x<height>. Without it, the size the app's first layout was built for.
